function.name: FADE_MUSIC_IN
function.param: Time to reboot the music in miliseconds
function.abstract: Play music raising the volume from 0 gradually

description.p: This function is equivalent to , but the music does not begin to play to high volume but that from silence, and it goes raising the volume gradually, until in a while indicated in the parameter miliseconds, the volume is full.

The second parameter indicates the number of times that must repeat the reproduction. We can use 0 for not to repeat it, or -1 for repeat it all time until it stops with . This function is specially useful for playing sound effects followed of this type (for example, environmental sound) instead of music.
